# setup
```{r}
library(readr)
library(powertools)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary) # table 1
library(tibble)
library(Hmisc)
library(survival)
library(survminer)
library(gridExtra)
data <- read_csv("frmgham2.csv")
```

```{r}
# check if everyone has baseline: true for everyone
baseline_check <- data %>%
  group_by(RANDID) %>%
  summarise(has_baseline = any(TIME == 0)) %>%
  ungroup()

table(baseline_check$has_baseline)
```

```{r}
# check if everyone has just one baseline: yes
baseline_count <- data %>%
  filter(TIME == 0) %>%
  count(RANDID)

table(baseline_count$n)
```


```{r}
# generate the dataset realy for analysis
analysis_baseline <- data %>%
  arrange(RANDID, TIME) %>% 
  group_by(RANDID) %>%
  filter(TIME == 0) %>%  # use the baseline
  ungroup() %>%
  transmute(
    id = RANDID,
    sex = factor(SEX,
                 levels = c(1, 2),
                 labels = c("Male", "Female")),
    age = AGE,
    chol = TOTCHOL,
    bp = SYSBP,
    smoke = factor(CURSMOKE,
                   levels = c(0, 1),
                   labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    bmi_raw = BMI,
    bmi_cat = case_when(
      BMI < 18.5 ~ "underweight",
      BMI >= 18.5 & BMI < 25 ~ "normal",
      BMI >= 25 ~ "overweight",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ) %>% factor(levels = c("underweight", "normal", "overweight")),
    diabetes = factor(DIABETES,
                      levels = c(0, 1),
                      labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    hd = factor(PREVCHD,
                levels = c(0, 1),
                labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    med = factor(BPMEDS,
                 levels = c(0, 1),
                 labels = c("No", "Yes")),
    # Outcome: censored at 10 years
    time_raw = TIMESTRK,
    stroke_raw = STROKE,
    time = pmin(TIMESTRK, 3652),
    stroke = ifelse(TIMESTRK > 3652, 0, STROKE)
  )
```

# data quality check
```{r}
# missingness check
missing_summary <- analysis_baseline %>%
  summarise(across(
    everything(),
    ~ sum(is.na(.))
  ))

missing_summary
```

```{r}
# check the range
cont_vars <- analysis_baseline %>%
  dplyr::select(age, chol, bp, bmi_raw)

summary(cont_vars)
```



# Table 1
```{r}
tbl1 <- analysis_baseline %>%
  dplyr::select(
    sex, age, chol, bp, smoke, bmi_cat, diabetes, hd, med
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = sex,
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    label = list(
      age = "Age",
      chol = "Total Cholesterol",
      bp = "Systolic Blood Pressure",
      smoke = "Current Smoker",
      bmi_cat = "BMI",
      diabetes = "Diabetes",
      hd = "Prevalent HD",
      med = "Anti-hypertensive Medications"
    ),
    missing = "ifany",
    digits = all_continuous() ~ 2,
  ) %>%
  add_overall(last = TRUE) %>%
  bold_labels()

tbl1
```

```{r}
vars_corr <- analysis_baseline %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    sex_num = as.numeric(sex == "Male"),
    smoke_num = as.numeric(smoke == "Yes"),
    bmi_bin = as.numeric(bmi_cat == "normal"),
    diabetes_num = as.numeric(diabetes == "Yes"),
    hd_num = as.numeric(hd == "Yes"),
    med_num = as.numeric(med == "Yes")
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    age, chol, bp,
    sex_num, smoke_num, bmi_bin, diabetes_num, hd_num, med_num
  )

cor_mat <- cor(vars_corr, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "pearson")
cor_df <- as.data.frame(round(cor_mat, 2))

cor_long <- cor_df %>%
  rownames_to_column("Var1") %>%
  pivot_longer(
    -Var1,
    names_to = "Var2",
    values_to = "Correlation"
  )

var_labels <- c(
  age = "Age",
  chol = "Cholesterol",
  bp = "Systolic BP",
  sex_num = "Male",
  smoke_num = "Current Smoker",
  bmi_bin = "BMI normal",
  diabetes_num = "Diabetes",
  hd_num = "Prevalent CHD",
  med_num = "Anti-hypertensive Meds"
)

var_order <- colnames(vars_corr)

cor_long <- cor_long %>%
  mutate(
    Var1 = factor(Var1, levels = var_order),
    Var2 = factor(Var2, levels = var_order)
  )

p <- ggplot(cor_long, aes(x = Var2, y = Var1, fill = Correlation)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", Correlation)), size = 4) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red",
    midpoint = 0, limits = c(-1, 1)
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = var_labels) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = var_labels) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  ) +
  ggtitle("Correlation Matrix")


ggsave(
  filename = "correlation_matrix_pearson.png", plot = p,
  width = 14, height = 12, dpi = 600, bg = "white")
```
